events.title: Dot-com bubble bursts
events.summary: The collapse of many internet stocks in 2000 exposed the gap between web speculation and durable business models, but it did not end the internet economy.
events.summaryZh: 2000 年许多互联网股票崩盘，暴露出网络投机与可持续商业模式之间的差距，但它并没有终结互联网经济。
events.eventIntro: In 2000, the speculative boom around internet companies broke sharply, especially on U.S. technology markets. Companies that had been valued on traffic, promise, and speed rather than profits suddenly faced capital scarcity, layoffs, and collapse.
events.eventIntroZh: 2000 年，围绕互联网公司的投机热潮急剧破裂，尤其体现在美国科技市场上。许多此前依靠流量、愿景和速度而非利润获得高估值的公司，突然面对资本枯竭、裁员和倒闭。
events.whyMatters: The crash separated web infrastructure from web hype. It punished fragile firms, but it also left behind fiber networks, data centers, user habits, engineering talent, and surviving platforms that later powered search, e-commerce, cloud services, and social media.
events.whyMattersZh: 这次崩盘把网络基础设施和网络泡沫区分开来。它惩罚了脆弱企业，但留下了光纤网络、数据中心、用户习惯、工程人才和幸存平台，后来支撑搜索、电商、云服务和社交媒体。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to the digital and platform economy phase because it marks the painful transition from speculative internet enthusiasm to a more disciplined platform capitalism.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“数字与平台经济”阶段，因为它标志着互联网狂热从投机性兴奋走向更严厉的平台资本主义纪律。
events.connectionHint: It connects to Google AdWords, enterprise Java, broadband platforms, and later cloud computing, because post-crash internet winners had to prove revenue, scale, and infrastructure discipline.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到 Google AdWords、企业 Java、宽带平台和后来的云计算，因为泡沫后幸存的互联网赢家必须证明收入、规模和基础设施纪律。
sourceNotes: The 2000 market turn is widely treated as the end of the first dot-com speculative boom.
events.imageAlt: Chart of the NASDAQ Composite during the dot-com bubble and crash.
events.imageCaption: The NASDAQ Composite chart visualizes the boom-and-crash shape that made the dot-com bubble a historical turning point.
events.imageCaptionZh: 纳斯达克综合指数图呈现了互联网泡沫作为历史转折点的暴涨与崩盘形态。

events.title: Google AdWords launches
events.summary: Google launched AdWords in 2000, helping turn search into an auction-based advertising business and a central platform economy model.
events.summaryZh: Google 于 2000 年推出 AdWords，推动搜索变成基于竞价的广告业务，并成为平台经济的核心模式。
events.eventIntro: Google introduced AdWords as a self-service advertising system that let businesses buy keyword-linked placement. Search advertising turned user intent into a measurable market rather than treating web pages only as display surfaces.
events.eventIntroZh: Google 推出 AdWords 作为自助广告系统，让商家可以购买与关键词相关的展示位置。搜索广告把用户意图转化为可计量市场，而不只是把网页当作展示广告位。
events.whyMatters: AdWords became one of the clearest answers to the post-bubble question of how the web would make money. It linked data, search, auctions, small business marketing, and global platform revenue into one repeatable model.
events.whyMattersZh: AdWords 成为泡沫破裂后“网络如何赚钱”这个问题最清晰的答案之一。它把数据、搜索、竞价、小企业营销和全球平台收入连接成一种可复制模式。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to the broadband, search, and platform web phase because it made search a commercial infrastructure for matching attention, intention, and advertisers.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“宽带、搜索与平台化网络”阶段，因为它让搜索成为连接注意力、意图与广告主的商业基础设施。
events.connectionHint: It connects to platform economics, surveillance debates, SEO, cloud analytics, and later AI search because advertising funded and shaped much of the public web.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到平台经济、监控争议、SEO、云分析和后来的 AI 搜索，因为广告资助并塑造了公共网络的很大一部分。
sourceNotes: Google's advertising platform is a key milestone in search and platform business history.
events.imageAlt: Google Ads logo, successor branding for Google's advertising platform.
events.imageCaption: Google's advertising platform turned search queries into one of the internet's most important revenue systems.
events.imageCaptionZh: Google 广告平台把搜索查询转化为互联网最重要的收入系统之一。

events.title: AOL and Time Warner announce merger
events.titleZh: AOL 与时代华纳宣布合并
events.summary: The announced AOL-Time Warner merger symbolized the ambition to fuse internet access, media libraries, cable systems, advertising, and entertainment into one conglomerate.
events.summaryZh: AOL 与时代华纳宣布合并，象征着把互联网接入、媒体内容、有线系统、广告和娱乐整合为同一巨型集团的雄心。
events.eventIntro: In January 2000, AOL and Time Warner announced what was then the largest corporate merger in U.S. history. The deal imagined that dial-up internet scale and traditional media assets could reinforce each other.
events.eventIntroZh: 2000 年 1 月，AOL 与时代华纳宣布当时美国历史上规模最大的企业合并。交易设想拨号互联网规模与传统媒体资产可以相互强化。
events.whyMatters: The merger became a cautionary symbol of the dot-com era. It showed both the appeal and the danger of assuming that internet distribution, legacy media, and corporate scale would automatically create digital convergence.
events.whyMattersZh: 这次合并后来成为互联网泡沫时代的警示符号。它显示了人们相信互联网分发、传统媒体和企业规模会自动产生数字融合的吸引力与危险。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to digital and platform economies because it captured a transitional moment when old media tried to buy its way into the internet future.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“数字与平台经济”阶段，因为它体现了旧媒体试图通过并购进入互联网未来的过渡时刻。
events.connectionHint: It connects to streaming media, platform consolidation, cable broadband, and later debates about whether media companies or technology platforms would control attention.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到流媒体、平台整合、有线宽带，以及后来关于媒体公司还是科技平台控制注意力的争论。
sourceNotes: The AOL-Time Warner deal is a standard example of dot-com era convergence logic.
events.imageCaption: The combined corporate name became a symbol of early internet convergence ambitions.
events.imageCaptionZh: 合并后的公司名称成为早期互联网融合雄心的象征。

events.title: ILOVEYOU worm spreads globally
events.summary: The ILOVEYOU worm spread through email attachments in 2000, showing how social engineering and connected office software could create global security incidents.
events.summaryZh: ILOVEYOU 蠕虫在 2000 年通过电子邮件附件传播，显示社交工程和互联办公软件如何制造全球安全事件。
events.eventIntro: In May 2000, an email with the subject line ILOVEYOU carried a malicious attachment that rapidly infected computers around the world. Its spread relied less on technical sophistication than on trust, curiosity, and weak default software behavior.
events.eventIntroZh: 2000 年 5 月，一封主题为 ILOVEYOU 的邮件携带恶意附件，迅速感染世界各地计算机。它的传播与其说依赖高深技术，不如说依赖信任、好奇心和软件默认行为的脆弱性。
events.whyMatters: ILOVEYOU made cybersecurity feel like an everyday social and organizational problem. Email, scripting, address books, and office networks became attack surfaces, not just communication tools.
events.whyMattersZh: ILOVEYOU 让网络安全显得像一个日常社会与组织问题。电子邮件、脚本、通讯录和办公网络不再只是沟通工具，也成为攻击面。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to the malware, botnets, and cybercrime phase because it showed how mass connectivity could turn small malicious code into global disruption.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“恶意软件、僵尸网络与网络犯罪”阶段，因为它显示大规模连接可以把小型恶意代码变成全球性破坏。
events.connectionHint: It connects to later phishing, ransomware, endpoint protection, and security awareness training because the human interface became part of the security system.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到后来的钓鱼攻击、勒索软件、终端防护和安全意识培训，因为人的界面成为安全系统的一部分。
sourceNotes: ILOVEYOU is a widely cited early global email worm incident.
events.imageAlt: Screenshot associated with the ILOVEYOU worm script.
events.imageCaption: The ILOVEYOU incident made ordinary email attachments part of global cybersecurity history.
events.imageCaptionZh: ILOVEYOU 事件让普通电子邮件附件进入全球网络安全史。

events.title: Human Genome Project draft announced
events.summary: The announcement of a draft human genome in 2000 showed biology becoming a data-intensive science organized around sequencing, computation, and international collaboration.
events.summaryZh: 2000 年人类基因组草图的公布，显示生物学正在成为围绕测序、计算和国际协作组织起来的数据密集型科学。
events.eventIntro: In June 2000, leaders of the public Human Genome Project and Celera Genomics announced draft sequences of the human genome. The milestone represented years of sequencing, automation, database work, and institutional competition.
events.eventIntroZh: 2000 年 6 月，公共人类基因组计划与 Celera Genomics 宣布人类基因组草图。这个里程碑代表了多年测序、自动化、数据库建设和机构竞争。
events.whyMatters: The draft genome changed expectations for medicine, biology, and data infrastructure. It did not instantly solve disease, but it made genomes, databases, sequencing machines, and bioinformatics central to life science.
events.whyMattersZh: 基因组草图改变了人们对医学、生物学和数据基础设施的期待。它没有立即解决疾病，但让基因组、数据库、测序机器和生物信息学成为生命科学的核心。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to the internet, AI, and biotech phase of science and technology because it made biological knowledge visibly computational and database-driven.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于科学技术中的“互联网、AI 与生物技术”阶段，因为它让生物知识明显变得计算化和数据库化。
events.connectionHint: It connects to databases, AI, personalized medicine, patent debates, and later sequencing platforms because biology increasingly became an information system.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到数据库、AI、个性化医学、专利争论和后来的测序平台，因为生物学越来越成为一种信息系统。
sourceNotes: The 2000 draft genome announcement is a core milestone in genomics and bioinformatics.
events.imageCaption: The Human Genome Project made DNA sequencing, databases, and international research infrastructure visible as one project.
events.imageCaptionZh: 人类基因组计划把 DNA 测序、数据库和国际研究基础设施呈现为同一个项目。

events.title: PlayStation 2 launches
events.summary: Sony's PlayStation 2 launched in 2000 and helped make game consoles into DVD players, living-room media devices, and global entertainment platforms.
events.summaryZh: 索尼 PlayStation 2 于 2000 年发布，推动游戏机成为 DVD 播放器、客厅媒体设备和全球娱乐平台。
events.eventIntro: Sony released the PlayStation 2 in Japan in March 2000 before launching it internationally. It combined games, DVD playback, brand loyalty, and third-party developer support into a dominant console platform.
events.eventIntroZh: 索尼于 2000 年 3 月在日本发布 PlayStation 2，随后推向国际市场。它把游戏、DVD 播放、品牌忠诚和第三方开发者支持结合成一个强势主机平台。
events.whyMatters: The PS2 showed how entertainment hardware could become a household media hub. Its success linked game culture to film distribution, semiconductor capability, global supply chains, and platform licensing.
events.whyMattersZh: PS2 显示娱乐硬件可以成为家庭媒体中心。它的成功把游戏文化连接到电影发行、半导体能力、全球供应链和平台授权。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to the video games and cable-era media phase because it helped make interactive entertainment a mainstream global media industry.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“电子游戏与有线电视时代媒介”阶段，因为它帮助互动娱乐成为全球主流媒体产业。
events.connectionHint: It connects to DVD adoption, Japanese consumer electronics, game studios, and later networked console platforms.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到 DVD 普及、日本消费电子、游戏工作室以及后来的联网主机平台。
sourceNotes: PlayStation 2 is a major milestone in console and home media history.
events.imageCaption: The PlayStation 2 turned the game console into a mass living-room media platform.
events.imageCaptionZh: PlayStation 2 把游戏主机变成大众客厅媒体平台。

events.title: The Sims released
events.summary: The Sims turned everyday domestic life into a best-selling simulation game and expanded what mainstream computer games could be about.
events.summaryZh: 《模拟人生》把日常家庭生活变成畅销模拟游戏，扩大了主流电脑游戏可以表现的主题范围。
events.eventIntro: Released by Maxis and Electronic Arts in 2000, The Sims let players manage households, relationships, work routines, architecture, and consumption rather than only combat or sport.
events.eventIntroZh: Maxis 与 Electronic Arts 于 2000 年发布《模拟人生》，让玩家管理家庭、关系、工作日程、建筑与消费，而不只是战斗或体育。
events.whyMatters: The Sims made simulation, modding, domestic design, and player storytelling central to PC gaming. Its audience also challenged narrow ideas about who games were for.
events.whyMattersZh: 《模拟人生》让模拟、模组、家庭设计和玩家叙事成为 PC 游戏的重要部分。它的受众也挑战了关于游戏玩家是谁的狭窄想象。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to the video games and cable-era media phase because it broadened game culture before social and mobile platforms made everyday simulation even more common.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“电子游戏与有线电视时代媒介”阶段，因为它在社交与移动平台让日常模拟更普遍之前，已经拓宽了游戏文化。
events.connectionHint: It connects to PC platforms, user-generated content, architecture games, gendered media audiences, and later life-simulation communities.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到 PC 平台、用户生成内容、建筑类游戏、性别化媒体受众以及后来的生活模拟社群。
sourceNotes: The Sims is a landmark personal-computer game release.
events.imageCaption: The Sims became a shorthand for domestic life simulation as mainstream computer entertainment.
events.imageCaptionZh: 《模拟人生》成为日常生活模拟进入主流电脑娱乐的代表。

events.title: Big Brother reality TV format spreads
events.summary: Big Brother's international spread in 2000 helped make reality television, surveillance formats, audience voting, and continuous media attention central to television culture.
events.summaryZh: 《老大哥》在 2000 年的国际扩散，推动真人秀、监控式节目、观众投票和持续媒体关注成为电视文化核心。
events.eventIntro: After its Dutch debut in 1999, Big Brother expanded rapidly in 2000, including high-profile versions in Britain and the United States. The format placed ordinary participants under constant observation and turned that observation into serialized television.
events.eventIntroZh: 《老大哥》1999 年在荷兰首播后，于 2000 年迅速扩展，包括英国和美国的高关注版本。节目把普通参与者置于持续观察之下，并把这种观察转化为连续电视内容。
events.whyMatters: The format changed television by merging surveillance, celebrity, audience participation, and low-cost production. It anticipated later platform cultures where ordinary life, performance, and monitoring blur together.
events.whyMattersZh: 这种模式通过结合监控、名人化、观众参与和低成本制作改变了电视。它预示了后来的平台文化：日常生活、表演和被观看逐渐混合。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to streaming, social media, and platforms because it prefigured always-on attention economies before social media made them everyday.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“流媒体、社交媒体与平台”阶段，因为它在社交媒体日常化之前，就预示了持续在线的注意力经济。
events.connectionHint: It connects to social media, influencer culture, privacy debates, and interactive media because viewers became part of the entertainment system.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到社交媒体、网红文化、隐私争论和互动媒体，因为观众成为娱乐系统的一部分。
sourceNotes: Big Brother's 2000 international expansion is a major reality television milestone.
events.imageAlt: Big Brother eye logo associated with the reality television format.
events.imageCaption: The eye logo made surveillance itself part of the show's media identity.
events.imageCaptionZh: 眼睛标识让“被观看”本身成为节目的媒体身份。

events.title: Tate Modern opens
events.summary: Tate Modern opened in a converted power station in 2000, turning industrial reuse, contemporary art, tourism, and global museum culture into one London landmark.
events.summaryZh: 泰特现代美术馆于 2000 年在改造后的发电站中开馆，把工业再利用、当代艺术、旅游和全球博物馆文化凝聚成伦敦地标。
events.eventIntro: Tate Modern opened to the public in May 2000 inside the former Bankside Power Station. The building's conversion turned a large industrial shell into a major contemporary art museum.
events.eventIntroZh: 泰特现代美术馆于 2000 年 5 月在原班克赛德发电站中向公众开放。建筑改造把巨大的工业外壳转变为重要的当代艺术博物馆。
events.whyMatters: The museum became a model for how cities use contemporary art, adaptive reuse, waterfront development, and global tourism to reshape cultural identity.
events.whyMattersZh: 这座美术馆成为城市如何利用当代艺术、适应性再利用、滨水开发和全球旅游重塑文化身份的典范。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to contemporary global art because museums, biennials, installations, and urban cultural districts became central to how contemporary art circulates.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“当代全球艺术”阶段，因为博物馆、双年展、装置和城市文化区成为当代艺术流通的核心。
events.connectionHint: It connects to architecture, urban regeneration, cultural tourism, and museum globalization.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到建筑、城市更新、文化旅游和博物馆全球化。
sourceNotes: Tate Modern's 2000 opening is a major contemporary art institution milestone.
events.imageCaption: Tate Modern's converted power station made contemporary art part of London's urban reinvention.
events.imageCaptionZh: 泰特现代美术馆由发电站改造而成，让当代艺术成为伦敦城市再造的一部分。

events.title: Millennium Bridge opens
events.summary: London's Millennium Bridge opened in 2000 as a pedestrian link between St Paul's Cathedral and Tate Modern, immediately becoming famous for unexpected lateral wobble.
events.summaryZh: 伦敦千禧桥于 2000 年开放，作为圣保罗大教堂与泰特现代之间的步行连接，并因意外横向晃动迅速成名。
events.eventIntro: The Millennium Bridge opened in June 2000 as a sleek pedestrian bridge across the Thames. Large crowds produced synchronized lateral movement, forcing closure and engineering modifications soon after opening.
events.eventIntroZh: 千禧桥于 2000 年 6 月作为横跨泰晤士河的轻巧步行桥开放。大量人群造成同步横向运动，使其开放后不久便关闭并进行工程改造。
events.whyMatters: The bridge became an unusually public lesson in design, urban spectacle, and structural dynamics. It showed that iconic architecture must also negotiate crowd behavior and engineering feedback.
events.whyMattersZh: 这座桥成为关于设计、城市景观和结构动力学的公共案例。它显示标志性建筑也必须处理人群行为和工程反馈。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to sustainable and computational architecture because contemporary architecture increasingly depends on modeling, performance testing, and public infrastructure behavior.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“可持续与计算建筑”阶段，因为当代建筑越来越依赖建模、性能测试和公共基础设施行为。
events.connectionHint: It connects to Tate Modern, urban regeneration, pedestrian infrastructure, and the politics of public design.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到泰特现代、城市更新、步行基础设施和公共设计政治。
sourceNotes: The bridge opening and closure are standard modern engineering case studies.
events.imageCaption: The Millennium Bridge linked contemporary cultural redevelopment with a memorable engineering problem.
events.imageCaptionZh: 千禧桥把当代文化再开发和一个令人难忘的工程问题连接起来。

events.title: China launches Western Development strategy
events.titleZh: 中国启动西部大开发战略
events.summary: China's Western Development strategy began in 2000, directing infrastructure, investment, and state planning toward inland western regions.
events.summaryZh: 中国西部大开发战略于 2000 年启动，把基础设施、投资和国家规划导向内陆西部地区。
events.eventIntro: In 2000, China launched the Western Development strategy to address regional inequality and integrate western provinces more deeply into national growth through infrastructure, resource development, and state-led investment.
events.eventIntroZh: 2000 年，中国启动西部大开发战略，试图通过基础设施、资源开发和国家主导投资，缓解区域不平衡并把西部省区更深地纳入国家增长。
events.whyMatters: The program shows how China's reform era was not only market liberalization but also territorial planning. Roads, railways, energy projects, urbanization, and migration became tools of state capacity.
events.whyMattersZh: 这一计划显示中国改革时代不只是市场化，也包含领土规划。道路、铁路、能源工程、城市化和迁移都成为国家能力的工具。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to postcolonial and global governance only in a broad state-capacity sense, but its primary meaning is China's modern regional development inside the Republican, socialist, and reform-era region phase.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它在广义国家能力层面可放入“后殖民与全球治理”阶段，但其主要意义在于中国现代区域发展，属于“民国、社会主义与改革时代”的地区脉络。
events.connectionHint: It connects to infrastructure, energy, urbanization, ethnic policy, domestic migration, and China's later Belt and Road infrastructure imagination.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到基础设施、能源、城市化、民族政策、国内迁移，以及中国后来的一带一路式基础设施想象。
sourceNotes: Western Development is a major Chinese state development strategy announced around 2000.
events.imageAlt: Map associated with China's Western Development regions.
events.imageCaption: Western Development was a territorial strategy for directing state investment toward inland western China.
events.imageCaptionZh: 西部大开发是一种把国家投资导向中国内陆西部的领土战略。

events.title: Vladimir Putin elected Russian president
events.titleZh: 弗拉基米尔·普京当选俄罗斯总统
events.summary: Vladimir Putin's 2000 election marked a consolidation point in post-Soviet Russian politics after the upheavals of the 1990s.
events.summaryZh: 普京 2000 年当选俄罗斯总统，标志着后苏联俄罗斯政治在 1990 年代动荡之后进入整合阶段。
events.eventIntro: In March 2000, Vladimir Putin won Russia's presidential election after serving as acting president. The election followed Boris Yeltsin's resignation and the turbulence of economic crisis, oligarchic power, and the second Chechen war.
events.eventIntroZh: 2000 年 3 月，普京在担任代总统后赢得俄罗斯总统选举。这次选举发生在叶利钦辞职之后，也承接了经济危机、寡头权力和第二次车臣战争的动荡。
events.whyMatters: The election became a turning point in the reconstruction of centralized executive power in Russia. It shaped media control, federal authority, security politics, energy-state relations, and later foreign policy.
events.whyMattersZh: 这次选举成为俄罗斯重建中央行政权力的转折点。它影响媒体控制、联邦权威、安全政治、能源国家关系以及后来的外交政策。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to the postcolonial and global governance phase through the post-Cold War reordering of sovereignty, state capacity, and great-power politics.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它通过后冷战主权、国家能力和大国政治的重组，属于“后殖民与全球治理”阶段。
events.connectionHint: It connects to post-Soviet state formation, energy geopolitics, Chechnya, NATO expansion debates, and later conflicts involving Russia.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到后苏联国家形成、能源地缘政治、车臣、北约扩张争论，以及后来与俄罗斯相关的冲突。
sourceNotes: Putin's 2000 election is a core event in post-Soviet Russian political history.
events.imageCaption: Putin's 2000 election signaled a new phase of centralized post-Soviet Russian politics.
events.imageCaptionZh: 普京 2000 年当选标志着后苏联俄罗斯集中化政治的新阶段。

events.title: Vicente Fox wins Mexican presidency
events.titleZh: 比森特·福克斯赢得墨西哥总统选举
events.summary: Vicente Fox's 2000 victory ended decades of PRI presidential dominance and marked a major electoral transition in modern Mexico.
events.summaryZh: 比森特·福克斯 2000 年胜选，结束了制度革命党数十年的总统垄断，标志着现代墨西哥的重要选举转型。
events.eventIntro: In July 2000, opposition candidate Vicente Fox won Mexico's presidential election. His victory ended the Institutional Revolutionary Party's uninterrupted control of the presidency since 1929.
events.eventIntroZh: 2000 年 7 月，反对党候选人比森特·福克斯赢得墨西哥总统选举，结束了制度革命党自 1929 年以来对总统职位的连续控制。
events.whyMatters: The election did not solve Mexico's political and social problems, but it changed the meaning of electoral competition. Democratic alternation became a visible part of Mexico's modern state history.
events.whyMattersZh: 这次选举没有解决墨西哥的政治与社会问题，但改变了选举竞争的意义。民主轮替成为墨西哥现代国家史中可见的一部分。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to postcolonial and global governance because it shows late twentieth-century democratization and party alternation inside a modern state system.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“后殖民与全球治理”阶段，因为它展现了现代国家体系中二十世纪末的民主化与政党轮替。
events.connectionHint: It connects to NAFTA-era economics, media politics, civil society, electoral institutions, and debates about democratic consolidation.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到 NAFTA 时代经济、媒体政治、公民社会、选举制度和民主巩固争论。
sourceNotes: The 2000 Mexican election is widely treated as a democratic transition milestone.
events.imageCaption: Vicente Fox's election made party alternation visible after decades of PRI presidential rule.
events.imageCaptionZh: 福克斯当选让制度革命党数十年总统统治后的政党轮替变得可见。

events.title: United Nations Millennium Summit
events.summary: The 2000 UN Millennium Summit produced the Millennium Declaration and helped organize global development goals around poverty, health, education, and international cooperation.
events.summaryZh: 2000 年联合国千年峰会通过《千年宣言》，并围绕贫困、健康、教育和国际合作组织全球发展目标。
events.eventIntro: World leaders met at the United Nations in September 2000 for the Millennium Summit. The resulting declaration helped frame a new era of measurable global development commitments.
events.eventIntroZh: 2000 年 9 月，世界领导人在联合国举行千年峰会。随后形成的宣言帮助开启了以可衡量全球发展承诺为特征的新阶段。
events.whyMatters: The summit showed global governance becoming more target-driven. It helped translate moral language about development into indicators, deadlines, aid programs, and institutional accountability.
events.whyMattersZh: 峰会显示全球治理正在变得更以目标为导向。它帮助把关于发展的道德语言转化为指标、期限、援助项目和制度问责。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to postcolonial and global governance because it organized international institutions around development, inequality, and cooperation after the Cold War.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“后殖民与全球治理”阶段，因为它在冷战后围绕发展、不平等和合作重新组织国际制度。
events.connectionHint: It connects to NGOs, development economics, public health, climate governance, and later Sustainable Development Goals.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到 NGO、发展经济学、公共卫生、气候治理和后来的可持续发展目标。
sourceNotes: The Millennium Summit and Millennium Declaration are core global governance milestones.
events.imageCaption: The Millennium Summit used the United Nations as a stage for measurable post-Cold War development commitments.
events.imageCaptionZh: 千年峰会以联合国为舞台，提出冷战后可衡量的发展承诺。

events.title: Second Intifada begins
events.titleZh: 第二次巴勒斯坦大起义开始
events.summary: The Second Intifada began in 2000, marking a violent breakdown in the Oslo-era peace process and reshaping Israeli-Palestinian politics.
events.summaryZh: 第二次巴勒斯坦大起义于 2000 年开始，标志着奥斯陆和平进程时代的暴力破裂，并重塑以巴政治。
events.eventIntro: In late September 2000, protests and violence escalated after Ariel Sharon's visit to the Temple Mount / Haram al-Sharif. The uprising became a prolonged and deadly phase of Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
events.eventIntroZh: 2000 年 9 月下旬，沙龙访问圣殿山 / 尊贵禁地后，抗议与暴力升级。这场起义成为以巴冲突中漫长而致命的新阶段。
events.whyMatters: The Second Intifada changed public trust, security policy, militant tactics, settlement politics, and the physical geography of separation. It made the optimism of the 1990s peace process far harder to sustain.
events.whyMattersZh: 第二次大起义改变了公共信任、安全政策、武装策略、定居点政治和隔离的物理地理。它使 1990 年代和平进程的乐观更难维持。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to post-Cold War asymmetric and networked conflict because it mixed occupation, insurgency, security infrastructure, media visibility, and diplomacy.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于后冷战非对称与网络化冲突阶段，因为它混合了占领、叛乱、安全基础设施、媒体可见性和外交。
events.connectionHint: It connects to religious sites, urban security, suicide bombings, walls and checkpoints, and the wider geopolitics of the Middle East.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到宗教圣地、城市安全、自杀式袭击、隔离墙与检查站，以及更广泛的中东地缘政治。
sourceNotes: The Second Intifada is a core event in modern Israeli-Palestinian conflict history.
events.imageAlt: Street confrontation during the Second Intifada.
events.imageCaption: The Second Intifada made urban protest, armed conflict, and security infrastructure central to the post-Oslo period.
events.imageCaptionZh: 第二次巴勒斯坦大起义让城市抗议、武装冲突和安全基础设施成为后奥斯陆时期的核心。

events.title: Kursk submarine disaster
events.summary: The sinking of the Russian submarine Kursk in 2000 exposed the risks of post-Soviet military decline, secrecy, and crisis response.
events.summaryZh: 俄罗斯库尔斯克号潜艇 2000 年沉没，暴露出后苏联军事衰退、保密文化和危机应对的风险。
events.eventIntro: In August 2000, the Russian nuclear-powered submarine Kursk sank during a naval exercise in the Barents Sea after onboard explosions. All 118 crew members died.
events.eventIntroZh: 2000 年 8 月，俄罗斯核动力潜艇库尔斯克号在巴伦支海军事演习中因艇内爆炸沉没，118 名船员全部遇难。
events.whyMatters: The disaster became a public test of the new Putin presidency and of Russia's military institutions. It raised questions about transparency, rescue capacity, naval maintenance, and the human costs of strategic prestige.
events.whyMattersZh: 这场灾难成为普京新总统任期和俄罗斯军事制度的公共考验。它引发了关于透明度、救援能力、海军维护和战略声望的人命代价的疑问。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to post-Cold War military history because it revealed the tension between inherited great-power military assets and weakened institutional capacity.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于后冷战军事史，因为它揭示了承继的大国军事资产与削弱的制度能力之间的张力。
events.connectionHint: It connects to submarine technology, nuclear fleets, state secrecy, media scrutiny, and post-Soviet institutional rebuilding.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到潜艇技术、核舰队、国家保密、媒体监督和后苏联制度重建。
sourceNotes: Kursk is a major post-Soviet naval disaster and crisis response event.
events.imageCaption: Kursk became a symbol of post-Soviet naval risk and crisis management failure.
events.imageCaptionZh: 库尔斯克号成为后苏联海军风险与危机管理失败的象征。

events.title: Mozambique floods
events.summary: Severe flooding in Mozambique in 2000 displaced hundreds of thousands and made climate, disaster response, poverty, and international relief visible together.
events.summaryZh: 2000 年莫桑比克严重洪灾造成数十万人流离失所，把气候、灾害应对、贫困和国际救援共同呈现出来。
events.eventIntro: In early 2000, heavy rains and cyclones produced devastating floods across Mozambique. Images of rescue operations and displaced communities circulated internationally.
events.eventIntroZh: 2000 年初，强降雨和热带气旋在莫桑比克造成严重洪灾。救援行动和流离失所社区的影像在国际上传播。
events.whyMatters: The floods showed how disaster is not only a weather event. Infrastructure, poverty, river systems, emergency capacity, global aid, and media attention shaped who was vulnerable and how help arrived.
events.whyMattersZh: 洪灾显示灾害不只是天气事件。基础设施、贫困、河流系统、应急能力、全球援助和媒体关注共同决定谁更脆弱以及援助如何抵达。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to adaptation and resilience debates because it makes visible the uneven social geography of climate-related disaster.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“适应与韧性争论”阶段，因为它让气候相关灾害的不均衡社会地理变得可见。
events.connectionHint: It connects to humanitarian logistics, disaster media, cyclone risk, development policy, and later climate adaptation planning.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到人道物流、灾害媒体、气旋风险、发展政策和后来的气候适应规划。
sourceNotes: The 2000 Mozambique floods are a major humanitarian disaster case.
events.imageCaption: The Mozambique floods linked extreme weather, displacement, and international relief politics.
events.imageCaptionZh: 莫桑比克洪灾把极端天气、流离失所和国际救援政治连接起来。

events.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon released
events.summary: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon brought wuxia aesthetics, transnational Chinese-language cinema, and global art-house/blockbuster circulation together in 2000.
events.summaryZh: 《卧虎藏龙》在 2000 年把武侠美学、跨国华语电影和全球艺术院线 / 商业大片流通连接在一起。
events.eventIntro: Ang Lee's Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon premiered in 2000 and became a global success. It combined martial-arts choreography, melodrama, landscape, and international production networks.
events.eventIntroZh: 李安执导的《卧虎藏龙》于 2000 年上映并获得全球成功。它结合武术动作设计、情感叙事、山水景观和国际制作网络。
events.whyMatters: The film showed that non-English-language cinema could circulate globally with both prestige and commercial force. It made wuxia legible to many international audiences without simply becoming Hollywood.
events.whyMattersZh: 这部电影显示非英语电影可以同时以声望和商业力量在全球流通。它让武侠对许多国际观众变得可读，同时并未简单变成好莱坞。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to digital effects, home video, and franchise-era cinema because global distribution, festival prestige, DVD markets, and transnational production shaped film circulation.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“数字特效、家庭录像与系列电影”阶段，因为全球发行、电影节声望、DVD 市场和跨国制作塑造了电影流通。
events.connectionHint: It connects to Chinese-language cinema, martial arts media, global art cinema, awards culture, and cross-Pacific film markets.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到华语电影、武术媒体、全球艺术电影、奖项文化和跨太平洋电影市场。
sourceNotes: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon is a landmark global Chinese-language film release.
events.imageAlt: Ang Lee, director of Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon.
events.imageCaption: Ang Lee's film became a global reference point for transnational wuxia cinema.
events.imageCaptionZh: 李安的这部电影成为跨国武侠电影的全球参照点。

events.title: In the Mood for Love released
events.summary: In the Mood for Love turned memory, urban intimacy, costume, music, and restrained performance into one of the defining works of global art cinema around 2000.
events.summaryZh: 《花样年华》把记忆、城市亲密关系、服装、音乐和克制表演凝聚成 2000 年前后全球艺术电影的代表作品之一。
events.eventIntro: Wong Kar-wai's In the Mood for Love premiered in 2000. Its stylized treatment of 1960s Hong Kong, missed intimacy, repetition, and visual rhythm became internationally influential.
events.eventIntroZh: 王家卫的《花样年华》于 2000 年首映。它对 1960 年代香港、错失的亲密、重复和视觉节奏的风格化处理产生了国际影响。
events.whyMatters: The film matters because it shows cinema as atmosphere, memory, and form rather than only plot. It became a touchstone for costume, music, cinematography, and transnational cinephile culture.
events.whyMattersZh: 这部电影的重要性在于它把电影呈现为空气感、记忆和形式，而不只是情节。它成为服装、音乐、摄影和跨国影迷文化的参照。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to the late twentieth-century global cinema phase because festival circuits, art-house distribution, and home video helped films travel as style and mood.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于二十世纪末全球电影阶段，因为电影节、艺术院线和家庭录像帮助电影以风格和氛围的方式流通。
events.connectionHint: It connects to Hong Kong cinema, fashion, urban memory, auteur culture, and global cinephile networks.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到香港电影、时尚、城市记忆、作者文化和全球影迷网络。
sourceNotes: In the Mood for Love is a canonical global art cinema release from 2000.
events.imageAlt: Wong Kar-wai, director of In the Mood for Love.
events.imageCaption: Wong Kar-wai's film made memory, style, and urban intimacy central to global art cinema.
events.imageCaptionZh: 王家卫的电影让记忆、风格和城市亲密关系成为全球艺术电影的核心。

events.title: USB flash drive enters the market
events.summary: The first USB flash drives entered commercial markets around 2000, making portable solid-state storage a familiar everyday computing object.
events.summaryZh: 第一批 USB 闪存盘在 2000 年前后进入商业市场，使便携式固态存储成为日常计算物件。
events.eventIntro: Around 2000, USB flash drives began to appear as small removable storage devices. They combined flash memory, USB connectivity, and plug-and-play convenience.
events.eventIntroZh: 2000 年前后，USB 闪存盘开始作为小型可移动存储设备出现。它们结合了闪存、USB 连接和即插即用便利性。
events.whyMatters: The device changed how ordinary users moved files between computers before cloud storage became normal. It also made miniaturization and solid-state storage tangible in daily work and school life.
events.whyMattersZh: 在云存储普及之前，这种设备改变了普通用户在电脑之间移动文件的方式。它也让小型化和固态存储在日常工作与学校生活中变得可触摸。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to mobile and cloud-connected personal devices because it marks portable data moving with the user, not staying inside one machine.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“移动与云连接个人设备”阶段，因为它标志数据开始随用户移动，而不是停留在单台机器内部。
events.connectionHint: It connects to flash memory, USB standards, office workflows, malware spread, and the later shift from portable media to cloud sync.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到闪存、USB 标准、办公流程、恶意软件传播，以及后来从便携介质转向云同步的变化。
sourceNotes: USB flash drives entered commercial use around 2000 through several manufacturers.
events.imageCaption: The USB flash drive made portable solid-state storage an everyday computing object.
events.imageCaptionZh: USB 闪存盘让便携式固态存储成为日常计算物件。

events.title: Enterprise Java enters platform era
events.titleZh: 企业 Java 进入平台期
events.summary: Around 2000, Java 2 Enterprise Edition helped standardize server-side enterprise application patterns for web-connected business systems.
events.summaryZh: 2000 年前后，Java 2 Enterprise Edition 帮助标准化面向 Web 连接商业系统的服务器端企业应用模式。
events.eventIntro: J2EE matured around 1999-2000 as a framework for enterprise Java applications. It organized servlets, application servers, transactions, messaging, and database access into a corporate software stack.
events.eventIntroZh: J2EE 在 1999 至 2000 年前后成熟为企业 Java 应用框架。它把 servlet、应用服务器、事务、消息和数据库访问组织成企业软件栈。
events.whyMatters: Enterprise Java helped make the web a serious enterprise application environment. Banks, retailers, governments, and large firms could build browser-facing systems while keeping business logic in managed server infrastructure.
events.whyMattersZh: 企业 Java 帮助 Web 成为严肃的企业应用环境。银行、零售商、政府和大型公司可以构建面向浏览器的系统，同时把业务逻辑放在受管理的服务器基础设施中。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to open source and web software because enterprise development moved toward standardized web servers, application containers, and reusable middleware.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“开源与 Web 软件”阶段，因为企业开发转向标准化 Web 服务器、应用容器和可复用中间件。
events.connectionHint: It connects to databases, ERP systems, application servers, cloud migration, and later microservice architectures.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到数据库、ERP 系统、应用服务器、云迁移和后来的微服务架构。
sourceNotes: J2EE's 1999-2000 platform period is central to enterprise web software history.
events.imageCaption: Enterprise Java made the Java ecosystem a major server-side web application platform.
events.imageCaptionZh: 企业 Java 让 Java 生态成为重要的服务器端 Web 应用平台。

events.title: Commercial GPRS mobile data begins
events.titleZh: GPRS 商用移动数据开始
events.summary: Commercial GPRS services around 2000 introduced packet-switched mobile data, preparing the ground for always-connected phones and later mobile internet.
events.summaryZh: 2000 年前后的 GPRS 商用服务引入分组交换移动数据，为始终联网手机和后来的移动互联网奠定基础。
events.eventIntro: Around 2000, operators began commercial GPRS services that let mobile networks transmit packet data more flexibly than earlier circuit-switched services.
events.eventIntroZh: 2000 年前后，运营商开始提供 GPRS 商用服务，使移动网络能比早期电路交换服务更灵活地传输分组数据。
events.whyMatters: GPRS was not yet the smartphone internet, but it changed the expectation that phones could carry data sessions, messaging, email, and lightweight web access. It was a bridge between GSM voice networks and mobile internet platforms.
events.whyMattersZh: GPRS 还不是智能手机互联网，但它改变了人们对手机的期待：手机可以承载数据会话、消息、邮件和轻量网页访问。它是 GSM 语音网络与移动互联网平台之间的桥梁。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to social and mobile internet because mobile data infrastructure made networked personal devices increasingly continuous and portable.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“社交与移动互联网”阶段，因为移动数据基础设施让联网个人设备越来越持续和便携。
events.connectionHint: It connects to smartphones, app stores, mobile carriers, location-based services, and platform control over mobile access.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到智能手机、应用商店、移动运营商、基于位置的服务，以及平台对移动接入的控制。
sourceNotes: Commercial GPRS deployments around 2000 are a key step toward mobile data networks.
events.imageCaption: GPRS made packet-switched mobile data part of everyday network infrastructure.
events.imageCaptionZh: GPRS 让分组交换移动数据成为日常网络基础设施的一部分。
